Jotaro lays still in order to draw in DIO, who appears to believe in Jotaro's death but remains cautious, a lesson he learned during his confrontations against Jonathan in the past.
In order to avoid Jotaro's immediate range, he grabs a sign and approaches, intending to sever Jotaro's head as proof of his demise.

outro.fallback: This is interrupted by the sudden intervention of Polnareff, who rushes in and manages to pierce DIO through the head with his Silver Chariot.
Although the surprise attack succeeds, DIO's vampire physiology renders the stab useless and he proceeds to strike down Polnareff through the use of The World.
